name: Stain Prep - int_door_slab
intent: Bare wood prep: sand for adhesion, patch any defects, clean surface, apply wood conditioner on softwood. Apply+wipe conditioner is one step via TSK_CONDITIONER_EA_SIDE — same shape as the trim LF version (TSK_CONDITIONER_LF) with EA_SIDE for doors.
doctrine: Stain prep for int_door_slab. Single sand pass (was 2-grit progression, simplified 2026-05-12). Patch defects via shared paint-side patch task. Clean dust via shared paint-side clean task. Conditioner on softwood only — one combined apply+wipe step via new universal TSK_CONDITIONER_EA_SIDE keeper (parallels TSK_CONDITIONER_LF used by all trim stain prep modules).
